title: Fixed window, limit 4 per 10 s: 8 requests get through in 4 seconds
caption: Every request is legal for its own window, but the client straddles the boundary at t = 10 s and gets double the rate.

messages.label: 4 requests at t = 8–9 s
messages.note: The first window is almost over and still empty: all 4 fit (count 4/4).

messages.label: 4 requests at t = 10–11 s
messages.note: A brand-new window starts with count 0, so 4 more fit immediately.

messages.label: all allowed (4/4)
messages.note: 8 requests in about 4 seconds, double the intended rate. Sliding windows and token buckets don't have this flaw.
